description: Suijin OS v5.2.0 — the field-readiness release. Red side: engagement console UI (syntax-highlighted tool calls, reasoning toggle, live token/cost strip with per-model pricing, loot capture), truthful event plumbing (no stale-tool re-execution, real failure markers, honest audit observations), fireteams with patient timeouts. Blue side: five foundation repairs (unified tarpit protocol, 9 detector classes ported to the core, custom rules wired, config-driven scorer). Plus: graded lab benchmark (suijin bench), payloadforge + containerbreak packs, and an installer that asks normal-vs-dev first and installs from your local checkout live. 1,383 tests green.
